description: Utterances that are CORRECT English. The analyzer must report ZERO findings for every one of these. This set is the false-positive guard (RISKS.md R2) and is deliberately full of the things a pedantic analyzer over-flags: contractions, fragments, informal speech, regional variation, and false starts that are normal in conversation.

cases.text: I went to the market yesterday and bought some clothes
Yeah, totally
cases.note: fragment; normal speech, not an error

If it rains tomorrow we'll cancel the trip
I look forward to meeting you next week
cases.note: correct gerund after look forward to
